name: WGPT sell hook burns treasury LP before crediting the deposit
summary: AiWGPTToken.transferFrom executes its treasury-funded LP removal and exact-output WGPT purchase before crediting the caller’s deposit to the pair. The hook updates pool reserves, then credits an unconsumed deposit that the caller can reclaim with skim. Repeated calls consume treasury LP and raise the WGPT price, allowing the caller to sell the retained tokens for USDT.
notes: The deployed sell hook updates pool reserves before crediting a reclaimable deposit. Pool registration, trading permission, treasury funding and LP-offset edits change exposure or loss size.

Net USDT depletion of the token contract and its WGPT/USDT pool, measured from all receipt Transfer events. Pool net change is -105212.230996130493027690 USDT and token-contract change is +22636.034519356989903313 USDT. This offsets all campaign inflows, including the attacker’s 30000 USDT treasury funding and initial swap inputs. Gross removal of treasury LP cannot be valued separately from the same transaction’s trades. Financing fees, gas and later recoveries are not deducted. Attacker reinvestment in its EXPToken/USDT pool is not another loss component.
